title: Unlocking High-Accuracy Differentially Private Image Classification through Scale
reasoning: Section 6, 'Discussion', addresses 'Privacy and fairness considerations,' discussing the implications of differentially private training for real-world applications on sensitive data, user-level privacy, and potential reduction in accuracy for 'under-represented subgroups' on imbalanced datasets. It also touches upon privacy risks from pre-training on public/non-sensitive data.
